messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Sanna, power cut in Muonio last night. BTS-210 came back by itself, didn't need the cold restart this time

messages.author: Sanna Siirto
messages.text: Yes! It was upgraded to 2.6 last month. 2.6 fixes the baseband not recovering after a power outage

messages.author: Sanna Siirto
messages.text: Only on the old ones still below 2.6. BTS-233 in Kolari is still on the old software, there you still need the cold restart
